function: GNN learns joint BS active beamforming and RIS passive phase shifts; SD3 deep RL learns the 3D trajectory of the UAV carrying the RIS (p. 7, p. 8).
system: BS with 16 antennas, 10 single-antenna users, UAV-mounted reflecting RIS with 100 elements and 2-bit phase shifts; carrier frequency not stated (p. 10).
method: GNN (RIS and UE nodes, 3 update layers) trained offline, unsupervised, on sum rate; SD3 reinforcement learning for the trajectory (p. 8, p. 11).
data_channel: Custom simulator: Rayleigh BS-UE, Rician BS-RIS, RIS-UE LoS/NLoS from cuboid buildings; random UE and UAV positions; no 3GPP or measured data (p. 4, p. 5, p. 8).
test_conditions: Trained with K = 100 RIS elements, tested with K from 20 to 180 without retraining (Fig. 9); sweeps of P_B, F, M not specified (p. 13).
baselines: Learned: SD3-DNN-RIS and TD3-DNN-RIS (DNN [48]); TD3, PPO, DDPG trajectory variants with the GNN. Non-learned: SD3-WMMSE-Random (WMMSE, random RIS), SD3-NO-RIS (p. 11).
metrics: Sum rate (bit/s/Hz) vs P_B, K, F, M; UAV energy consumption (kJ); reward convergence; UAV trajectories; GNN training and testing time (p. 11, p. 13).
complexity: Runtime of the GNN beamformer: training 2.18 h, testing 7.2 s for 5,120 samples, versus DNN 2.48 h and 27.4 s; no complexity order (p. 11).
q1_support: p. 4: "is blocked and modeled as Rayleigh fading"; p. 5: "we describe the A2G urban channel model" with cuboid buildings. A custom simulator; no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 13: "was trained with 100 RIS elements" and "applicable across scenarios with varying numbers of RIS elements without requiring specific training for each different number of RIS elements".
q3_support: p. 11: "the RIS coefficients are initialized with random value" (SD3-WMMSE-Random, non-learned) and "managed by a DNN [48]" (SD3-DNN-RIS, learned); p. 13: "reliably exceeds the performance of other algorithms in all scenarios" (sum rate, Figs. 8-11).
q4_support: p. 11: "the testing phase takes 7.2 seconds for a test sample size of 5,120"; only the runtime of the GNN is reported, with no complexity order or parameter count for the full method.
q5_support: p. 10: "The major simulation parameters are summarized in Table II"; no code or data link is given and the channels are simulated.
notes: Included: the GNN learns BS precoder and RIS phase shifts (PHY) jointly with the UAV trajectory by SD3 (above PHY), so check 4 is passed. Area 6 by the specificity order because the RIS is carried by a UAV (aerial links, A2G channel, learned beams plus trajectory); the alternative is area 3 by function. The paper never says NTN. Fig. 4 trains the GNN for several K, yet p. 13 says K = 100 was used for training. The non-learned baseline shares the SD3 trajectory with the proposed method. For q1, p. 10: "building placements determined according to the statistical model in [14]" is not named as 3GPP or ITU-R, so it is treated as a custom model.
